text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for APAC-east1 canary pool (canary-03) — surge in 429/503 and memory growth on nodes. Incident INC-2026-451. Dashboard: <https://dash.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-451>

arjun: ack, I'm on it. picking up logs and heap profiles now.

maria: I’m taking primary for the afternoon window — will coordinate handoff to tanvi in ~25m. sam you free to be secondary? :wave:

sam: secondary here. can help with rolling restarts and quick hotfixes.

arjun: quick snapshot: pod inference-canary-03-7f8c shows RSS growth ~+600MB over 20m, KV cache size monotonically increases. GC not recovering. stack trace hints at large kv entries for repeated short requests.

arjun: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T14:04:12Z INFO kv_cache: insert key=usr-12345 size=8420
2026-03-17T14:06:31Z WARN mem: RSS=3.8GB heap_alloc=2.6GB kv_entries=13421
2026-03-17T14:14:02Z ERROR response: 429 request_id=xyz node=canary-03
```

jeff: customer impact: APAC-east latency p95 up from 180ms -> 720ms, ~0.8% of production requests getting 429s in last 10m (mostly low-traffic tenants). No cross-region spill yet.

maria: runbook: <https://confluence.redwood-internal/runbooks/canary-memory-leak>. Short checklist: 1) remove canary traffic 2) drain pod set 3) restart canary deployment 4) monitor KV eviction config.

sam: executing first mitigation: redirect traffic off canary-03 to stable pool and scale canary to 0. Command:
```
# remove canary weight
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://routing-api.internal/route -d '{"pool":"canary-03","weight":0}'
kubectl scale deploy inference-canary-03 -n inference --replicas=0
```

arjun: confirming: successful scale to 0, pods terminating. memory drain observed on node nodes/apac-gpu-12.

incident-bot: Update INC-2026-451 — mitigation applied: canary traffic shifted. Auto-alert silenced for canary-03. (link: <https://dash.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-451/updates/1>)

jeff: metrics improving: p95 down to ~210ms, 429 rate falling. Marking current status: degraded -> stabilizing.

maria: next steps for handoff: arjun will follow up to scrub heap dumps and produce a short RCA draft. sam to run a full canary restart after the root cause patch is identified. tanvi will be primary for evening; tanvi pls ack and take notes.

tanvi: ack, will take the evening window at 15:00 UTC. I'll keep watch on APAC and run the eviction/quantization quick checks per runbook. Contact: @sam for escalations, @arjun for diagnostic artifacts.

arjun: attaching location for heap dumps and traces: s3://redwood-internal/incidents/INC-2026-451/artifacts

maria: summary for the handoff:
- What happened: KV cache leak observed on canary causing memory growth -> increased latency and 429s.
- Current status: Traffic removed from canary; pods scaled down; metrics stabilizing.
- Owners: arjun (diagnostics/RCA), sam (mitigations/rollout), tanvi (evening oncall primary).
- Next steps: collect traces, reproduce on staging, patch eviction logic, plan safe canary reintroduce.

jeff: marking customer impact note for postmortem and notifying support for any tenant followups.

tanvi: got it. I’ll post quick checks in 20m and start a follow-up thread if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — good quick coordination. leaving this thread for tanvi and arjun to continue. closing bridge in 10m unless new alerts show up.
